qa.recommendation: Keep Bitterfeld power station and Wolfen Envia power station as two separate plants.
qa.note: The national regulator's power plant list dated 26 June 2026 has two separate rows for the operator envia THERM GmbH. One is Bitterfeld GuD, a gas and steam turbine plant commissioned in 2000 with 110 MW gross and 108 MW net. The other is Wolfen GT, a single gas turbine without heat recovery commissioned in 1996 with 50 MW. They have different register numbers, years and technology, so they are not the same plant recorded twice. An envia THERM press release describes the Bitterfeld plant as a 108 MW gas and steam turbine plant that started in 2000. Both sit in the same chemical park, which explains why the coordinates are close.
